lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity vertical bands intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating a lattice where primary nodes coincide with the centroids of the circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible across the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance increase on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing immediately ventral to each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density clustering of smaller high-luminance blobs, which are less uniform in size compared to those on the lateral flank.
